meaning:
ἐδαφίζω (ἔδαφος)
[in LXX chiefly for רטשׁ pu. ;]
1. to beat level like a threshing floor (Theophr.).
2. to dash to the ground (Field, Notes, 74): Luk.19:44 (cf. Psa.136(137):9, Hos.14:1).
† (AS)
